## This release

Read-only reclaim reports now skip the folder identity lookups used to guard
cleanup. The MCP server reuses candidate discovery across pages while checking
protected paths on every request. In a Windows test with 256 candidates, each
page required 3 other I/O operations, down from 771 in v0.1.5.

Windows NTFS MFT scans build entries directly in the final list. The CLI and
MCP server also skip the live folder view used by the desktop. On a warm
24,771-entry synthetic image, the median peak working set fell from 31.2 MiB
to 28.9 MiB across eight paired runs comparing the collector change and
headless mode against the preceding reclaim-only build.

A torn MFT record can hide a worktree's Git pointer. RillDisk now withholds
orphan suggestions that depend on a complete directory listing when it finds
such damage. If an automatic MFT scan fails and falls back to a directory
walk, progress and the desktop live view restart with that walk.
